content.text: Torch and transformers are installed. Next I'll generate reference data: a prefix of token IDs, the greedy continuation, and the top logits from an fp32 HF model. The fp32 model uses the same bf16 weight values the engine will read, so it's a fair comparison target.

input.command:
cd /tmp/claude-1000/-home-t-projects-project/774c728a-3cca-42f0-bc4f-34304c77ee08/scratchpad/ref && cat > mkref.py <<'EOF'
import sys, struct, torch, numpy as np
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
M="/home/t/projects/project/model/Qwen3-0.6B"
tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(M)
model=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(M, torch_dtype=torch.float32).eval()
prompts=["The capital of France is", "def fibonacci(n):\n    \"\"\"Return the nth Fibonacci number.\"\"\"\n"]
for i,p in enumerate(prompts):
    ids=tok(p, return_tensors="pt").input_ids
    print("prompt",i,ids.tolist())
    with torch.no_grad():
        out=model.generate(ids, max_new_tokens=24, do_sample=False, eos_token_id=None, pad_token_id=151643)
        full=out[0].tolist()
        out_logits=model(ids).logits[0,-1]
    gen=full[ids.shape[1]:]
    print("greedy gen:", gen, repr(tok.decode(gen)))
    top=torch.topk(out_logits,5)
    print("top5 last-pos logits:", list(zip(top.indices.tolist(), [round(x,4) for x in top.values.tolist()])))
    with open(f"prefix{i}.u32","wb") as f: f.write(struct.pack(f"<{len(ids[0])}I", *ids[0].tolist()))
    with open(f"gen{i}.u32","wb") as f: f.write(struct.pack(f"<{len(gen)}I", *gen))
    np.save(f"logits{i}.npy", out_logits.numpy())
EOF

Weights and tokenizer are in place, and the fp32 reference works. Before writing the engine, here are the design decisions:

- **No tokenizer in the engine.** The input is already token IDs, so the engine only needs the transformer.
- **Weights stay bf16 in the file.** Converting bf16 to f32 is a 16-bit shift, so there's no 2.4 GB f32 copy. The engine maps the weights read-only.
- **Attach trailer.** The attach script appends a page-aligned blob plus a 24-byte trailer. At startup the engine reads `/proc/self/exe`, finds the trailer, and mmaps the blob.
- **Pure asm, no libc.** The Python script does the JSON and layout work. Everything else is x86-64 AVX2/FMA: matvec, RMSNorm, RoPE, attention, and a polynomial `exp`.

I'll write the engine now.

# qwen3.s - Qwen3-0.6B greedy decoder, x86-64 Linux, AVX2 + FMA, no libc.
#
#   stdin     prefix as little-endian u32 token IDs (read until EOF)
#   stdout    generated token IDs as little-endian u32, one write() per token
#   argv[1]   optional cap on generated tokens (default: until EOS or context full)
#   exit      0 ok, 1 usage, 2 weights missing/mismatched, 3 read error,
#             4 bad prefix, 5 write error, 6 out of memory
#
# Weights are read from a blob appended to this executable by
# tools/attach_weights.py. Weights are bf16 in the blob and are converted to
# f32 on the fly; activations, KV cache and accumulation are f32.
#
# Notes on the implementation:
#   * Prefill runs in groups of up to 4 tokens so each weight row is read once
#     per group; decode runs one token at a time.
#   * Logits are only computed for the last prefix token and for decoded tokens.
#   * Sampling is greedy argmax (first index wins ties).

.intel_syntax noprefix

.set H,        1024
.set NL,       28
.set NH,       16
.set NKV,      8
.set HD,       128
.set QD,       2048          # NH * HD
.set KVD,      1024          # NKV * HD
.set FF,       3072
.set VOCAB,    151936
.set MAXCTX,   8192
.set EOS_A,    151643        # <|endoftext|>
.set EOS_B,    151645        # <|im_end|>
.set NSLOTS,   312           # 2 + NL*11 + 2 (see attach_weights.py)
.set SLOT_COS, 310
.set SLOT_SIN, 311
.set KV_BYTES, 939524096     # NL * MAXCTX * KVD * 4

# Helper macros ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load the blob pointer for weight kind k (0 ln1, 1 q, 2 k, 3 v, 4 o,
# 5 q_norm, 6 k_norm, 7 ln2, 8 gate, 9 up, 10 down) of layer g_fw_layer.
.macro LSLOT dst, k
    mov \dst, qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer]
    imul \dst, \dst, 11
    add \dst, \k+2
    lea r11, [rip+g_slots]
    mov \dst, qword ptr [r11+\dst*8]
.endm

# Horizontal sum of ymm \y into the low lane \x (xmm), scratch xmm \t.
.macro HSUM y, x, t
    vextractf128 \t, \y, 1
    vaddps \x, \x, \t
    vmovhlps \t, \t, \x
    vaddps \x, \x, \t
    vpshufd \t, \x, 0x55
    vaddss \x, \x, \t
.endm

# 8 copies of a float, for packed memory operands.
.macro VEC name, val
    .align 32
\name:
    .rept 8
    .float \val
    .endr
.endm

# ==========================================================================
.section .text

.globl _start
_start:
    mov qword ptr [rip+g_max_new], -1
    mov rax, [rsp]                       # argc
    cmp rax, 2
    jb .Lnoarg
    mov rdi, [rsp+16]                    # argv[1]
    call parse_decimal
    test rdx, rdx
    jnz .Lusage
    mov [rip+g_max_new], rax
.Lnoarg:

    # --- locate the weight trailer at the end of /proc/self/exe -------------
    mov eax, 2                           # open
    lea rdi, [rip+s_self]
    xor esi, esi
    xor edx, edx
    syscall
    test rax, rax
    js .Lno_weights
    mov [rip+g_fd], rax

    mov rdi, rax                         # lseek(fd, 0, SEEK_END)
    xor esi, esi
    mov edx, 2
    mov eax, 8
    syscall
    cmp rax, 24
    jb .Lno_weights
    lea rsi, [rax-24]
    mov rdi, [rip+g_fd]
    xor edx, edx                         # lseek(fd, size-24, SEEK_SET)
    mov eax, 8
    syscall

    mov rdi, [rip+g_fd]                  # read(fd, trailer, 24)
    lea rsi, [rip+g_trailer]
    mov edx, 24
    xor eax, eax
    syscall
    cmp rax, 24
    jne .Lno_weights
    mov rax, [rip+magic_trl]
    cmp rax, [rip+g_trailer+16]
    jne .Lno_weights
    mov r13, [rip+g_trailer]             # blob offset in file (page aligned)
    mov r14, [rip+g_trailer+8]           # blob size

    xor edi, edi                         # mmap(NULL, size, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, off)
    mov rsi, r14
    mov edx, 1
    mov r10d, 2
    mov r8, [rip+g_fd]
    mov r9, r13
    mov eax, 9
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4096
    ja .Lmmap_fail
    mov [rip+g_blob], rax

    # --- validate blob header and build the slot table ---------------------
    mov rsi, [rip+g_blob]
    mov rax, [rip+magic_blob]
    cmp rax, [rsi]
    jne .Lbad_blob
    lea rdi, [rip+expect_cfg]
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lcfg_loop:
    mov eax, dword ptr [rsi+rcx*4+16]
    cmp eax, dword ptr [rdi+rcx*4]
    jne .Lbad_blob
    inc rcx
    cmp rcx, 8
    jb .Lcfg_loop

    lea rdi, [rip+g_slots]
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lslot_loop:
    mov rax, [rsi+rcx*8+48]
    add rax, rsi
    mov [rdi+rcx*8], rax
    inc rcx
    cmp rcx, NSLOTS
    jb .Lslot_loop

    # --- KV caches (lazily committed anonymous memory) ----------------------
    mov eax, 9                           # mmap(NULL, KV_BYTES, RW, PRIVATE|ANON|NORESERVE)
    xor edi, edi
    mov rsi, KV_BYTES
    mov edx, 3
    mov r10d, 0x4022
    mov r8, -1
    xor r9d, r9d
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4096
    ja .Lkv_fail
    mov [rip+g_kcache], rax

    mov eax, 9
    xor edi, edi
    mov rsi, KV_BYTES
    mov edx, 3
    mov r10d, 0x4022
    mov r8, -1
    xor r9d, r9d
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4096
    ja .Lkv_fail
    mov [rip+g_vcache], rax

    # --- read the prefix from stdin -----------------------------------------
    xor r15d, r15d                       # bytes read so far
.Lread:
    lea rsi, [rip+g_tokbuf]
    add rsi, r15
    mov rdx, MAXCTX*4+4
    sub rdx, r15
    xor edi, edi
    xor eax, eax                         # read(0, ...)
    syscall
    test rax, rax
    js .Lread_fail
    jz .Lread_done
    add r15, rax
    cmp r15, MAXCTX*4
    ja .Lpref_long
    jmp .Lread
.Lread_done:
    test r15, 3
    jnz .Lpref_partial
    test r15, r15
    jz .Lpref_empty
    shr r15, 2                           # r15 = number of prefix tokens
    mov [rip+g_ntok], r15

    lea rsi, [rip+g_tokbuf]              # validate token IDs
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lval:
    cmp rcx, r15
    jae .Lval_ok
    mov eax, dword ptr [rsi+rcx*4]
    cmp eax, VOCAB
    jae .Lpref_range
    inc rcx
    jmp .Lval
.Lval_ok:

    # --- prefill in groups of up to 4 tokens -------------------------------
    xor r12d, r12d                       # p = first prefix token of the group
.Lpf:
    mov r13, [rip+g_ntok]
    sub r13, r12                         # remaining
    mov r14, r13
    cmp r14, 4
    jbe .Lpf_nb
    mov r14, 4
.Lpf_nb:
    lea rdi, [rip+g_tokbuf]
    lea rdi, [rdi+r12*4]
    mov rsi, r12                         # p0
    mov rdx, r14                         # nb
    lea rcx, [r12+r14]
    xor eax, eax
    cmp rcx, [rip+g_ntok]
    sete al
    mov rcx, rax                         # want logits only for the last token
    call forward
    add r12, r14
    cmp r12, [rip+g_ntok]
    jb .Lpf

    # --- decode -------------------------------------------------------------
    mov rax, [rip+g_ntok]
    mov [rip+g_pos], rax
.Ldec:
    mov rax, [rip+g_count]
    cmp rax, [rip+g_max_new]
    jae .Lfinish
    mov eax, dword ptr [rip+g_next]      # emit
    mov dword ptr [rip+g_outbuf], eax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_outbuf]
    mov edx, 4
.Lwrite:
    mov edi, 1
    mov eax, 1
    syscall
    test rax, rax
    jle .Lwrite_fail
    add rsi, rax
    sub rdx, rax
    jnz .Lwrite
    inc qword ptr [rip+g_count]

    mov eax, dword ptr [rip+g_next]
    cmp eax, EOS_A
    je .Lfinish
    cmp eax, EOS_B
    je .Lfinish
    mov rax, [rip+g_pos]
    cmp rax, MAXCTX
    jae .Lfinish                         # context full

    lea rdi, [rip+g_next]                # feed the new token at position pos
    mov rsi, rax
    mov edx, 1
    mov ecx, 1
    call forward
    inc qword ptr [rip+g_pos]
    jmp .Ldec

.Lfinish:
    xor edi, edi
    mov eax, 231                         # exit_group(0)
    syscall

# --- error exits ------------------------------------------------------------
.Lusage:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_usage]
    mov edi, 1
    call die
.Lno_weights:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_no_weights]
    mov edi, 2
    call die
.Lmmap_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_mmap]
    mov edi, 2
    call die
.Lbad_blob:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_bad_blob]
    mov edi, 2
    call die
.Lkv_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_kv]
    mov edi, 6
    call die
.Lread_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_read]
    mov edi, 3
    call die
.Lpref_long:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_long]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lpref_partial:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_partial]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lpref_empty:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_empty]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lpref_range:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_range]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lwrite_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_write]
    mov edi, 5
    call die

# ==========================================================================
# parse_decimal: rdi = NUL-terminated string -> rax = value, rdx = 0 ok / 1 bad
parse_decimal:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lpd:
    movzx r8d, byte ptr [rdi+rcx]
    test r8d, r8d
    jz .Lpd_end
    sub r8d, 48
    cmp r8d, 9
    ja .Lpd_bad
    imul rax, rax, 10
    add rax, r8
    inc rcx
    jmp .Lpd
.Lpd_end:
    test rcx, rcx
    jz .Lpd_bad
    xor edx, edx
    ret
.Lpd_bad:
    mov edx, 1
    ret

# die: edi = exit code, rsi = NUL-terminated message (written to stderr)
die:
    mov r12d, edi
    xor edx, edx
.Lddl:
    cmp byte ptr [rsi+rdx], 0
    je .Ldw
    inc rdx
    jmp .Lddl
.Ldw:
    mov edi, 2
    mov eax, 1
    syscall
    mov edi, r12d
    mov eax, 231
    syscall

# ==========================================================================
# bf16_to_f32: rdi = dst f32, rsi = src bf16, rdx = n (multiple of 8)
bf16_to_f32:
    xor eax, eax
.Lb2f:
    vpmovzxwd ymm0, XMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*2]
    vpslld ymm0, ymm0, 16
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm0
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rdx
    jb .Lb2f
    vzeroupper
    ret

# rmsnorm: dst = src * rsqrt(mean(src^2) + eps) * w
#   rdi = dst f32, rsi = src f32 (may equal dst), rdx = w bf16, rcx = n (multiple of 8)
rmsnorm:
    mov r8, rcx
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    xor eax, eax
.Lrn_ss:
    vmovups ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm1, ymm1
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rcx
    jb .Lrn_ss
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm1
    vcvtsi2ss xmm1, xmm1, r8d
    vdivss xmm0, xmm0, xmm1              # mean of squares
    vaddss xmm0, xmm0, DWORD PTR [rip+S_EPS]
    vsqrtss xmm0, xmm0, xmm0
    vmovss xmm1, DWORD PTR [rip+S_ONE]
    vdivss xmm0, xmm1, xmm0              # 1 / rms
    vbroadcastss ymm2, xmm0
    xor eax, eax
.Lrn_sc:
    vmovups ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vmulps ymm1, ymm1, ymm2
    vpmovzxwd ymm3, XMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*2]
    vpslld ymm3, ymm3, 16
    vmulps ymm1, ymm1, ymm3
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm1
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rcx
    jb .Lrn_sc
    vzeroupper
    ret

# rope (rotate-half, as in HF Qwen3): rdi = base of heads (f32, 128 per head),
#   rsi = number of heads, rdx = position
rope:
    mov rax, rdx
    shl rax, 8                           # pos * 64 floats * 4 bytes
    lea r8, [rip+g_slots]
    mov r9, qword ptr [r8+SLOT_COS*8]
    add r9, rax
    mov r10, qword ptr [r8+SLOT_SIN*8]
    add r10, rax
    xor r11d, r11d
.Lrope_h:
    cmp r11, rsi
    jae .Lrope_done
    mov rax, r11
    shl rax, 9                           # head * 128 * 4
    lea rcx, [rdi+rax]
    xor eax, eax
.Lrope_i:
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4]        # x1 = q[i]
    vmovups ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4+256]    # x2 = q[i+64]
    vmovups ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*4]         # cos
    vmovups ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [r10+rax*4]        # sin
    vmulps ymm4, ymm0, ymm2
    vfnmadd231ps ymm4, ymm1, ymm3                # x1*cos - x2*sin
    vmulps ymm5, ymm1, ymm2
    vfmadd231ps ymm5, ymm0, ymm3                 # x2*cos + x1*sin
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4], ymm4
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4+256], ymm5
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, 64
    jb .Lrope_i
    inc r11
    jmp .Lrope_h
.Lrope_done:
    vzeroupper
    ret

# matvec: dst[b][r] = sum_c W[r][c] * X[b][c], W bf16 row-major
#   rdi = dst f32 (batch stride = rows), rsi = W bf16, rdx = X f32 (batch stride = cols),
#   rcx = rows, r8 = cols (multiple of 32), r9 = nb (batch size)
matvec:
    mov [rip+g_mv_dst], rdi
    mov [rip+g_mv_w], rsi
    mov [rip+g_mv_x], rdx
    mov [rip+g_mv_rows], rcx
    mov [rip+g_mv_cols], r8
    mov [rip+g_mv_nb], r9
.Lmv_loop:
    mov r9, [rip+g_mv_nb]
    test r9, r9
    jz .Lmv_ret
    mov rdi, [rip+g_mv_dst]
    mov rsi, [rip+g_mv_w]
    mov rdx, [rip+g_mv_x]
    mov rcx, [rip+g_mv_rows]
    mov r8, [rip+g_mv_cols]
    cmp r9, 4
    jb .Lmv_one
    call kernel4
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_rows]
    shl rax, 4                           # 4 outputs * rows * 4 bytes
    add [rip+g_mv_dst], rax
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_cols]
    shl rax, 4
    add [rip+g_mv_x], rax
    sub qword ptr [rip+g_mv_nb], 4
    jmp .Lmv_loop
.Lmv_one:
    call kernel1
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_rows]
    shl rax, 2
    add [rip+g_mv_dst], rax
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_cols]
    shl rax, 2
    add [rip+g_mv_x], rax
    dec qword ptr [rip+g_mv_nb]
    jmp .Lmv_loop
.Lmv_ret:
    ret

# kernel1: one batch vector. rdi dst, rsi W, rdx x, rcx rows, r8 cols
kernel1:
    xor r10d, r10d
    mov r9, rsi
.Lk1_row:
    cmp r10, rcx
    jae .Lk1_done
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vxorps ymm1, ymm1, ymm1
    vxorps ymm2, ymm2, ymm2
    vxorps ymm3, ymm3, ymm3
    xor eax, eax
.Lk1_col:
    vpmovzxwd ymm4, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2]
    vpmovzxwd ymm5, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2+16]
    vpmovzxwd ymm6, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2+32]
    vpmovzxwd ymm7, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2+48]
    vpslld ymm4, ymm4, 16
    vpslld ymm5, ymm5, 16
    vpslld ymm6, ymm6, 16
    vpslld ymm7, ymm7, 16
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm1, ymm5, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4+32]
    vfmadd231ps ymm2, ymm6, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4+64]
    vfmadd231ps ymm3, ymm7, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4+96]
    add rax, 32
    cmp rax, r8
    jb .Lk1_col
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, ymm1
    vaddps ymm2, ymm2, ymm3
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, ymm2
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm4
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4], xmm0
    lea r9, [r9+r8*2]
    inc r10
    jmp .Lk1_row
.Lk1_done:
    vzeroupper
    ret

# kernel4: four batch vectors at once (x0 = rdx, x_i = x0 + i*cols) and outputs
#   at rdi + i*rows. Same arguments as kernel1.
kernel4:
    push rbx
    push rbp
    push r12
    push r13
    push r14
    push r15
    mov rax, r8
    shl rax, 2                           # cols * 4 bytes
    lea r12, [rdx+rax]
    lea r13, [r12+rax]
    lea r14, [r13+rax]
    mov rax, rcx
    shl rax, 2                           # rows * 4 bytes
    lea r15, [rdi+rax]
    lea rbp, [r15+rax]
    lea rbx, [rbp+rax]
    mov r9, rsi
    xor r10d, r10d
.Lk4_row:
    cmp r10, rcx
    jae .Lk4_done
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vxorps ymm1, ymm1, ymm1
    vxorps ymm2, ymm2, ymm2
    vxorps ymm3, ymm3, ymm3
    xor eax, eax
.Lk4_col:
    vpmovzxwd ymm4, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2]
    vpslld ymm4, ymm4, 16
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm1, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [r12+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm2, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [r13+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm3, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [r14+rax*4]
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, r8
    jb .Lk4_col
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm4
    HSUM ymm1, xmm1, xmm4
    HSUM ymm2, xmm2, xmm4
    HSUM ymm3, xmm3, xmm4
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4], xmm0
    vmovss DWORD PTR [r15+r10*4], xmm1
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rbp+r10*4], xmm2
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rbx+r10*4], xmm3
    lea r9, [r9+r8*2]
    inc r10
    jmp .Lk4_row
.Lk4_done:
    vzeroupper
    pop r15
    pop r14
    pop r13
    pop r12
    pop rbp
    pop rbx
    ret

# exp8: ymm0 = exp(ymm0) for 8 lanes. Clobbers ymm0-ymm3 only.
#   Range reduction x = n*ln2 + r, polynomial for exp(r) (Cephes expf), 2^n by bit construction.
exp8:
    vminps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_EXPHI]
    vmaxps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_EXPLO]
    vmulps ymm1, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_LOG2E]
    vroundps ymm1, ymm1, 0               # n = round(x / ln2), nearest
    vmovaps ymm2, ymm0
    vfnmadd231ps ymm2, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_LN2HI]
    vfnmadd231ps ymm2, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_LN2LO]     # r = x - n*ln2
    vmovups ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P0]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P1]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P2]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P3]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P4]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P5]      # p = poly(r)
    vmulps ymm0, ymm2, ymm2                              # r^2
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm0, ymm2                         # p = p*r^2 + r
    vaddps ymm3, ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_ONE]           # exp(r)
    vcvtps2dq ymm1, ymm1
    vpaddd ymm1, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_I127]
    vpslld ymm1, ymm1, 23                                # 2^n
    vmulps ymm0, ymm3, ymm1
    ret

# silu_mul: gate[i] = silu(gate[i]) * up[i]
#   rdi = gate f32, rsi = up f32, rdx = n (multiple of 8)
silu_mul:
    xor eax, eax
.Lsm:
    vmovups ymm5, YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4]        # g
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vsubps ymm0, ymm0, ymm5                      # -g
    call exp8
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_ONE]   # 1 + exp(-g)
    vdivps ymm1, ymm5, ymm0                      # g * sigmoid(g)
    vmulps ymm1, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm1
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rdx
    jb .Lsm
    vzeroupper
    ret

# add_vec: dst[i] += src[i]. rdi = dst, rsi = src, rdx = n (multiple of 8)
add_vec:
    xor eax, eax
.Lav:
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4]
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm0
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rdx
    jb .Lav
    vzeroupper
    ret

# argmax: rdi = f32 array, rsi = n -> eax = index of first maximum
argmax:
    xor eax, eax
    vmovss xmm0, DWORD PTR [rdi]
    mov ecx, 1
.Lam:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jae .Lam_done
    vmovss xmm1, DWORD PTR [rdi+rcx*4]
    vucomiss xmm1, xmm0
    jbe .Lam_next
    vmovaps xmm0, xmm1
    mov eax, ecx
.Lam_next:
    inc rcx
    jmp .Lam
.Lam_done:
    ret

# attention for one query position (all 16 query heads, GQA 2:1).
#   rdi = q (16 heads x 128), rsi = K cache base for this layer,
#   rdx = V cache base for this layer, rcx = out (16 x 128), r8 = T (number of keys)
#   Key/value row t lives at base + t*KVD*4; kv head j at j*128*4.
attention:
    push rbx
    push rbp
    push r12
    push r13
    push r14
    push r15
    mov r12, rdi                         # q
    mov r13, rsi                         # K base
    mov r14, rdx                         # V base
    mov r15, rcx                         # out
    mov rbx, r8                          # T
    xor ebp, ebp                         # head
.Lat_head:
    cmp rbp, NH
    jae .Lat_done
    mov rax, rbp
    shr rax, 1
    shl rax, 9                           # kv head * 128 * 4
    lea rdx, [r13+rax]                   # K head base
    lea rcx, [r14+rax]                   # V head base
    mov r8, rbp
    shl r8, 9
    add r8, r12                          # q head

    # scores[t] = (q . k_t) / sqrt(HD)
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_sc:
    cmp r9, rbx
    jae .Lat_sc_done
    mov rsi, r9
    shl rsi, 12                          # t * KVD * 4
    add rsi, rdx
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vxorps ymm1, ymm1, ymm1
    xor r10d, r10d
.Lat_dot:
    vmovups ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [r8+r10*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+r10*4]
    vmovups ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [r8+r10*4+32]
    vfmadd231ps ymm1, ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+r10*4+32]
    add r10, 16
    cmp r10, HD
    jb .Lat_dot
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, ymm1
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm2
    vmulss xmm0, xmm0, DWORD PTR [rip+S_SCALE]
    lea rax, [rip+g_scores]
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], xmm0
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_sc
.Lat_sc_done:

    # pad to a multiple of 8 with a very negative value
    lea rax, [rip+g_scores]
    mov r10, rbx
    add r10, 7
    and r10, -8                          # Tpad
    mov r9, rbx
    vmovss xmm3, DWORD PTR [rip+S_NEG]
.Lat_pad:
    cmp r9, r10
    jae .Lat_pad_done
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], xmm3
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_pad
.Lat_pad_done:

    # softmax: max, exp(x - max), normalise
    vmovss xmm1, DWORD PTR [rax]
    mov r9, 1
.Lat_max:
    cmp r9, rbx
    jae .Lat_max_done
    vmaxss xmm1, xmm1, DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_max
.Lat_max_done:
    vbroadcastss ymm7, xmm1
    vxorps ymm8, ymm8, ymm8
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_exp:
    cmp r9, r10
    jae .Lat_exp_done
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    vsubps ymm0, ymm0, ymm7
    call exp8
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], ymm0
    vaddps ymm8, ymm8, ymm0
    add r9, 8
    jmp .Lat_exp
.Lat_exp_done:
    HSUM ymm8, xmm8, xmm2
    vmovss xmm2, DWORD PTR [rip+S_ONE]
    vdivss xmm8, xmm2, xmm8
    vbroadcastss ymm9, xmm8
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_norm:
    cmp r9, r10
    jae .Lat_norm_done
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    vmulps ymm0, ymm0, ymm9
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], ymm0
    add r9, 8
    jmp .Lat_norm
.Lat_norm_done:

    # out_head = sum_t p[t] * v_t
    mov rdi, rbp
    shl rdi, 9
    add rdi, r15                         # out head
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    xor eax, eax
.Lat_zero:
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm0
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, HD
    jb .Lat_zero
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_acc:
    cmp r9, rbx
    jae .Lat_acc_done
    lea rax, [rip+g_scores]
    vbroadcastss ymm1, DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    mov rsi, r9
    shl rsi, 12
    add rsi, rcx                         # V row t, this kv head
    xor r10d, r10d
.Lat_acc_d:
    vmovups ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm2, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+r10*4]
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4], ymm2
    add r10, 8
    cmp r10, HD
    jb .Lat_acc_d
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_acc
.Lat_acc_done:
    inc rbp
    jmp .Lat_head
.Lat_done:
    vzeroupper
    pop r15
    pop r14
    pop r13
    pop r12
    pop rbp
    pop rbx
    ret

# ==========================================================================
# forward: process nb tokens (1..4) at positions p0 .. p0+nb-1.
#   rdi = pointer to nb u32 token IDs, rsi = p0, rdx = nb, rcx = want logits (0/1)
#   If want != 0, the argmax of the last token's logits is stored in g_next.
forward:
    push rbx
    push rbp
    push r12
    push r13
    push r14
    push r15
    mov [rip+g_fw_tok], rdi
    mov [rip+g_fw_p0], rsi
    mov [rip+g_fw_nb], rdx
    mov [rip+g_fw_want], rcx

    # embedding: x[b] = embed[token[b]]
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_emb:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_emb_done
    mov rax, [rip+g_fw_tok]
    mov eax, dword ptr [rax+rbx*4]
    imul rax, rax, H*2
    mov rsi, qword ptr [rip+g_slots]
    add rsi, rax
    mov rdi, rbx
    shl rdi, 12
    lea rax, [rip+g_x]
    add rdi, rax
    mov edx, H
    call bf16_to_f32
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_emb
.Lfw_emb_done:
    mov qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer], 0

.Lfw_layer:
    # ---- attention block ----------------------------------------------------
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_ln1:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_ln1_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_xn]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_x]
    add rsi, rax
    LSLOT rdx, 0
    mov ecx, H
    call rmsnorm
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_ln1
.Lfw_ln1_done:

    lea rdi, [rip+g_q]
    LSLOT rsi, 1
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, QD
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_k]
    LSLOT rsi, 2
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, KVD
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_v]
    LSLOT rsi, 3
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, KVD
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    # per-head QK RMSNorm, RoPE
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_qk:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_qk_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 13                          # b * QD * 4
    lea r12, [rip+g_q]
    add r12, rax
    xor r13d, r13d
.Lfw_qn:
    cmp r13, NH
    jae .Lfw_qn_done
    mov rax, r13
    shl rax, 9
    lea rdi, [r12+rax]
    mov rsi, rdi
    LSLOT rdx, 5
    mov ecx, HD
    call rmsnorm
    inc r13
    jmp .Lfw_qn
.Lfw_qn_done:
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12                          # b * KVD * 4
    lea r12, [rip+g_k]
    add r12, rax
    xor r13d, r13d
.Lfw_kn:
    cmp r13, NKV
    jae .Lfw_kn_done
    mov rax, r13
    shl rax, 9
    lea rdi, [r12+rax]
    mov rsi, rdi
    LSLOT rdx, 6
    mov ecx, HD
    call rmsnorm
    inc r13
    jmp .Lfw_kn
.Lfw_kn_done:

    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 13
    lea rdi, [rip+g_q]
    add rdi, rax
    mov esi, NH
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add rdx, rbx
    call rope

    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_k]
    add rdi, rax
    mov esi, NKV
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add rdx, rbx
    call rope
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_qk
.Lfw_qk_done:

    # write K and V for every batch position into the cache
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_kv:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_kv_done
    mov rax, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add rax, rbx                         # position
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_layer]
    imul rdx, rdx, MAXCTX
    add rdx, rax
    shl rdx, 12                          # (layer*MAXCTX + pos) * KVD * 4
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12                          # b * KVD * 4
    mov rdi, [rip+g_kcache]
    add rdi, rdx
    lea rsi, [rip+g_k]
    add rsi, rax
    mov ecx, KVD/2
    rep movsq
    mov rdi, [rip+g_vcache]
    add rdi, rdx
    lea rsi, [rip+g_v]
    add rsi, rax
    mov ecx, KVD/2
    rep movsq
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_kv
.Lfw_kv_done:

    # attention per batch position (causal: only keys 0..pos)
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_att:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_att_done
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_layer]
    imul rdx, rdx, MAXCTX*4096           # layer * MAXCTX * KVD * 4
    mov r9, rdx
    mov rsi, [rip+g_kcache]
    add rsi, r9
    mov rdx, [rip+g_vcache]
    add rdx, r9
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 13
    lea rdi, [rip+g_q]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rcx, [rip+g_att]
    add rcx, rax
    mov r8, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add r8, rbx
    inc r8                               # T = pos + 1
    call attention
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_att
.Lfw_att_done:

    # output projection and residual
    lea rdi, [rip+g_tmp]
    LSLOT rsi, 4
    lea rdx, [rip+g_att]
    mov ecx, H
    mov r8d, QD
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_res1:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_res1_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_x]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_tmp]
    add rsi, rax
    mov edx, H
    call add_vec
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_res1
.Lfw_res1_done:

    # MLP: xn = rmsnorm(x) * ln2; h = silu(gate(xn)) * up(xn); x += down(h)
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_ln2:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_ln2_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_xn]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_x]
    add rsi, rax
    LSLOT rdx, 7
    mov ecx, H
    call rmsnorm
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_ln2
.Lfw_ln2_done:

    lea rdi, [rip+g_gate]
    LSLOT rsi, 8
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, FF
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_up]
    LSLOT rsi, 9
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, FF
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_silu:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_silu_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 14                          # b * FF * 4
    lea rdi, [rip+g_gate]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_up]
    add rsi, rax
    mov edx, FF
    call silu_mul
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_silu
.Lfw_silu_done:

    lea rdi, [rip+g_tmp]
    LSLOT rsi, 10
    lea rdx, [rip+g_gate]
    mov ecx, H
    mov r8d, FF
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_res2:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_res2_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_x]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_tmp]
    add rsi, rax
    mov edx, H
    call add_vec
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_res2
.Lfw_res2_done:

    inc qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer]
    cmp qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer], NL
    jb .Lfw_layer

    # ---- final norm + tied LM head (logits = embed . xn) --------------------
    cmp qword ptr [rip+g_fw_want], 0
    je .Lfw_ret
    mov rax, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    dec rax
    shl rax, 12
    lea rsi, [rip+g_x]
    add rsi, rax
    lea rdi, [rip+g_xn]
    mov rdx, qword ptr [rip+g_slots+8]   # model.norm.weight
    mov ecx, H
    call rmsnorm

    lea rdi, [rip+g_logits]
    mov rsi, qword ptr [rip+g_slots]     # embed (V x H), used as lm_head
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, VOCAB
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9d, 1
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_logits]
    mov esi, VOCAB
    call argmax
    mov [rip+g_next], eax

.Lfw_ret:
    pop r15
    pop r14
    pop r13
    pop r12
    pop rbp
    pop rbx
    ret

.section .rodata
s_self:      .asciz "/proc/self/exe"
magic_blob:  .ascii "QWN3BLOB"
magic_trl:   .ascii "QWN3TRL1"
.align 4

msg_usage:      .asciz "usage: qwen3 [max_new_tokens] < prefix.u32 > tokens.u32\n"

.align 32
VEC V_EXPHI,  88.3762626647949
VEC V_EXPLO,  -87.3365
VEC V_LOG2E,  1.44269504088896341
VEC V_LN2HI,  0.693359375
VEC V_LN2LO,  -2.12194440e-4
VEC V_P0,     1.9875691500e-4
VEC V_P1,     1.3981999507e-3
VEC V_P2,     8.3334519073e-3
VEC V_P3,     4.1665795894e-2
VEC V_P4,     1.6666665459e-1
VEC V_P5,     5.0000001201e-1
VEC V_ONE,    1.0
.align 32
V_I127:
    .rept 8
    .long 127
    .endr
S_ONE:   .float 1.0
S_EPS:   .float 0.000001
S_SCALE: .float 0.08838834764831845      # 1/sqrt(128)

.section .bss
.align 64
g_slots:    .skip NSLOTS*8               # blob pointers, one per tensor slot
g_trailer:  .skip 32
g_fd:       .skip 8
g_blob:     .skip 8

g_vcache:   .skip 8
g_max_new:  .skip 8

toolu_011p9EVuaKRjKUiCZcobrca3.content:
# qwen3.s - Qwen3-0.6B greedy decoder, x86-64 Linux, AVX2 + FMA, no libc.
#
#   stdin     prefix as little-endian u32 token IDs (read until EOF)
#   stdout    generated token IDs as little-endian u32, one write() per token
#   argv[1]   optional cap on generated tokens (default: until EOS or context full)
#   exit      0 ok, 1 usage, 2 weights missing/mismatched, 3 read error,
#             4 bad prefix, 5 write error, 6 out of memory
#
# Weights are read from a blob appended to this executable by
# tools/attach_weights.py. Weights are bf16 in the blob and are converted to
# f32 on the fly; activations, KV cache and accumulation are f32.
#
# Notes on the implementation:
#   * Prefill runs in groups of up to 4 tokens so each weight row is read once
#     per group; decode runs one token at a time.
#   * Logits are only computed for the last prefix token and for decoded tokens.
#   * Sampling is greedy argmax (first index wins ties).

.intel_syntax noprefix

.set H,        1024
.set NL,       28
.set NH,       16
.set NKV,      8
.set HD,       128
.set QD,       2048          # NH * HD
.set KVD,      1024          # NKV * HD
.set FF,       3072
.set VOCAB,    151936
.set MAXCTX,   8192
.set EOS_A,    151643        # <|endoftext|>
.set EOS_B,    151645        # <|im_end|>
.set NSLOTS,   312           # 2 + NL*11 + 2 (see attach_weights.py)
.set SLOT_COS, 310
.set SLOT_SIN, 311
.set KV_BYTES, 939524096     # NL * MAXCTX * KVD * 4

# Helper macros ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load the blob pointer for weight kind k (0 ln1, 1 q, 2 k, 3 v, 4 o,
# 5 q_norm, 6 k_norm, 7 ln2, 8 gate, 9 up, 10 down) of layer g_fw_layer.
.macro LSLOT dst, k
    mov \dst, qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer]
    imul \dst, \dst, 11
    add \dst, \k+2
    lea r11, [rip+g_slots]
    mov \dst, qword ptr [r11+\dst*8]
.endm

# Horizontal sum of ymm \y into the low lane \x (xmm), scratch xmm \t.
.macro HSUM y, x, t
    vextractf128 \t, \y, 1
    vaddps \x, \x, \t
    vmovhlps \t, \t, \x
    vaddps \x, \x, \t
    vpshufd \t, \x, 0x55
    vaddss \x, \x, \t
.endm

# 8 copies of a float, for packed memory operands.
.macro VEC name, val
    .align 32
\name:
    .rept 8
    .float \val
    .endr
.endm

# ==========================================================================
.section .text

.globl _start
_start:
    mov qword ptr [rip+g_max_new], -1
    mov rax, [rsp]                       # argc
    cmp rax, 2
    jb .Lnoarg
    mov rdi, [rsp+16]                    # argv[1]
    call parse_decimal
    test rdx, rdx
    jnz .Lusage
    mov [rip+g_max_new], rax
.Lnoarg:

    # --- locate the weight trailer at the end of /proc/self/exe -------------
    mov eax, 2                           # open
    lea rdi, [rip+s_self]
    xor esi, esi
    xor edx, edx
    syscall
    test rax, rax
    js .Lno_weights
    mov [rip+g_fd], rax

    mov rdi, rax                         # lseek(fd, 0, SEEK_END)
    xor esi, esi
    mov edx, 2
    mov eax, 8
    syscall
    cmp rax, 24
    jb .Lno_weights
    lea rsi, [rax-24]
    mov rdi, [rip+g_fd]
    xor edx, edx                         # lseek(fd, size-24, SEEK_SET)
    mov eax, 8
    syscall

    mov rdi, [rip+g_fd]                  # read(fd, trailer, 24)
    lea rsi, [rip+g_trailer]
    mov edx, 24
    xor eax, eax
    syscall
    cmp rax, 24
    jne .Lno_weights
    mov rax, [rip+magic_trl]
    cmp rax, [rip+g_trailer+16]
    jne .Lno_weights
    mov r13, [rip+g_trailer]             # blob offset in file (page aligned)
    mov r14, [rip+g_trailer+8]           # blob size

    xor edi, edi                         # mmap(NULL, size, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, off)
    mov rsi, r14
    mov edx, 1
    mov r10d, 2
    mov r8, [rip+g_fd]
    mov r9, r13
    mov eax, 9
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4096
    ja .Lmmap_fail
    mov [rip+g_blob], rax

    # --- validate blob header and build the slot table ---------------------
    mov rsi, [rip+g_blob]
    mov rax, [rip+magic_blob]
    cmp rax, [rsi]
    jne .Lbad_blob
    lea rdi, [rip+expect_cfg]
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lcfg_loop:
    mov eax, dword ptr [rsi+rcx*4+16]
    cmp eax, dword ptr [rdi+rcx*4]
    jne .Lbad_blob
    inc rcx
    cmp rcx, 8
    jb .Lcfg_loop

    lea rdi, [rip+g_slots]
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lslot_loop:
    mov rax, [rsi+rcx*8+48]
    add rax, rsi
    mov [rdi+rcx*8], rax
    inc rcx
    cmp rcx, NSLOTS
    jb .Lslot_loop

    # --- KV caches (lazily committed anonymous memory) ----------------------
    mov eax, 9                           # mmap(NULL, KV_BYTES, RW, PRIVATE|ANON|NORESERVE)
    xor edi, edi
    mov rsi, KV_BYTES
    mov edx, 3
    mov r10d, 0x4022
    mov r8, -1
    xor r9d, r9d
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4096
    ja .Lkv_fail
    mov [rip+g_kcache], rax

    mov eax, 9
    xor edi, edi
    mov rsi, KV_BYTES
    mov edx, 3
    mov r10d, 0x4022
    mov r8, -1
    xor r9d, r9d
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4096
    ja .Lkv_fail
    mov [rip+g_vcache], rax

    # --- read the prefix from stdin -----------------------------------------
    xor r15d, r15d                       # bytes read so far
.Lread:
    lea rsi, [rip+g_tokbuf]
    add rsi, r15
    mov rdx, MAXCTX*4+4
    sub rdx, r15
    xor edi, edi
    xor eax, eax                         # read(0, ...)
    syscall
    test rax, rax
    js .Lread_fail
    jz .Lread_done
    add r15, rax
    cmp r15, MAXCTX*4
    ja .Lpref_long
    jmp .Lread
.Lread_done:
    test r15, 3
    jnz .Lpref_partial
    test r15, r15
    jz .Lpref_empty
    shr r15, 2                           # r15 = number of prefix tokens
    mov [rip+g_ntok], r15

    lea rsi, [rip+g_tokbuf]              # validate token IDs
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lval:
    cmp rcx, r15
    jae .Lval_ok
    mov eax, dword ptr [rsi+rcx*4]
    cmp eax, VOCAB
    jae .Lpref_range
    inc rcx
    jmp .Lval
.Lval_ok:

    # --- prefill in groups of up to 4 tokens -------------------------------
    xor r12d, r12d                       # p = first prefix token of the group
.Lpf:
    mov r13, [rip+g_ntok]
    sub r13, r12                         # remaining
    mov r14, r13
    cmp r14, 4
    jbe .Lpf_nb
    mov r14, 4
.Lpf_nb:
    lea rdi, [rip+g_tokbuf]
    lea rdi, [rdi+r12*4]
    mov rsi, r12                         # p0
    mov rdx, r14                         # nb
    lea rcx, [r12+r14]
    xor eax, eax
    cmp rcx, [rip+g_ntok]
    sete al
    mov rcx, rax                         # want logits only for the last token
    call forward
    add r12, r14
    cmp r12, [rip+g_ntok]
    jb .Lpf

    # --- decode -------------------------------------------------------------
    mov rax, [rip+g_ntok]
    mov [rip+g_pos], rax
.Ldec:
    mov rax, [rip+g_count]
    cmp rax, [rip+g_max_new]
    jae .Lfinish
    mov eax, dword ptr [rip+g_next]      # emit
    mov dword ptr [rip+g_outbuf], eax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_outbuf]
    mov edx, 4
.Lwrite:
    mov edi, 1
    mov eax, 1
    syscall
    test rax, rax
    jle .Lwrite_fail
    add rsi, rax
    sub rdx, rax
    jnz .Lwrite
    inc qword ptr [rip+g_count]

    mov eax, dword ptr [rip+g_next]
    cmp eax, EOS_A
    je .Lfinish
    cmp eax, EOS_B
    je .Lfinish
    mov rax, [rip+g_pos]
    cmp rax, MAXCTX
    jae .Lfinish                         # context full

    lea rdi, [rip+g_next]                # feed the new token at position pos
    mov rsi, rax
    mov edx, 1
    mov ecx, 1
    call forward
    inc qword ptr [rip+g_pos]
    jmp .Ldec

.Lfinish:
    xor edi, edi
    mov eax, 231                         # exit_group(0)
    syscall

# --- error exits ------------------------------------------------------------
.Lusage:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_usage]
    mov edi, 1
    call die
.Lno_weights:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_no_weights]
    mov edi, 2
    call die
.Lmmap_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_mmap]
    mov edi, 2
    call die
.Lbad_blob:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_bad_blob]
    mov edi, 2
    call die
.Lkv_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_kv]
    mov edi, 6
    call die
.Lread_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_read]
    mov edi, 3
    call die
.Lpref_long:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_long]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lpref_partial:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_partial]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lpref_empty:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_empty]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lpref_range:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_range]
    mov edi, 4
    call die
.Lwrite_fail:
    lea rsi, [rip+msg_write]
    mov edi, 5
    call die

# ==========================================================================
# parse_decimal: rdi = NUL-terminated string -> rax = value, rdx = 0 ok / 1 bad
parse_decimal:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.Lpd:
    movzx r8d, byte ptr [rdi+rcx]
    test r8d, r8d
    jz .Lpd_end
    sub r8d, 48
    cmp r8d, 9
    ja .Lpd_bad
    imul rax, rax, 10
    add rax, r8
    inc rcx
    jmp .Lpd
.Lpd_end:
    test rcx, rcx
    jz .Lpd_bad
    xor edx, edx
    ret
.Lpd_bad:
    mov edx, 1
    ret

# die: edi = exit code, rsi = NUL-terminated message (written to stderr)
die:
    mov r12d, edi
    xor edx, edx
.Lddl:
    cmp byte ptr [rsi+rdx], 0
    je .Ldw
    inc rdx
    jmp .Lddl
.Ldw:
    mov edi, 2
    mov eax, 1
    syscall
    mov edi, r12d
    mov eax, 231
    syscall

# ==========================================================================
# bf16_to_f32: rdi = dst f32, rsi = src bf16, rdx = n (multiple of 8)
bf16_to_f32:
    xor eax, eax
.Lb2f:
    vpmovzxwd ymm0, XMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*2]
    vpslld ymm0, ymm0, 16
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm0
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rdx
    jb .Lb2f
    vzeroupper
    ret

# rmsnorm: dst = src * rsqrt(mean(src^2) + eps) * w
#   rdi = dst f32, rsi = src f32 (may equal dst), rdx = w bf16, rcx = n (multiple of 8)
rmsnorm:
    mov r8, rcx
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    xor eax, eax
.Lrn_ss:
    vmovups ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm1, ymm1
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rcx
    jb .Lrn_ss
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm1
    vcvtsi2ss xmm1, xmm1, r8d
    vdivss xmm0, xmm0, xmm1              # mean of squares
    vaddss xmm0, xmm0, DWORD PTR [rip+S_EPS]
    vsqrtss xmm0, xmm0, xmm0
    vmovss xmm1, DWORD PTR [rip+S_ONE]
    vdivss xmm0, xmm1, xmm0              # 1 / rms
    vbroadcastss ymm2, xmm0
    xor eax, eax
.Lrn_sc:
    vmovups ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vmulps ymm1, ymm1, ymm2
    vpmovzxwd ymm3, XMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*2]
    vpslld ymm3, ymm3, 16
    vmulps ymm1, ymm1, ymm3
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm1
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rcx
    jb .Lrn_sc
    vzeroupper
    ret

# rope (rotate-half, as in HF Qwen3): rdi = base of heads (f32, 128 per head),
#   rsi = number of heads, rdx = position
rope:
    mov rax, rdx
    shl rax, 8                           # pos * 64 floats * 4 bytes
    lea r8, [rip+g_slots]
    mov r9, qword ptr [r8+SLOT_COS*8]
    add r9, rax
    mov r10, qword ptr [r8+SLOT_SIN*8]
    add r10, rax
    xor r11d, r11d
.Lrope_h:
    cmp r11, rsi
    jae .Lrope_done
    mov rax, r11
    shl rax, 9                           # head * 128 * 4
    lea rcx, [rdi+rax]
    xor eax, eax
.Lrope_i:
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4]        # x1 = q[i]
    vmovups ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4+256]    # x2 = q[i+64]
    vmovups ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*4]         # cos
    vmovups ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [r10+rax*4]        # sin
    vmulps ymm4, ymm0, ymm2
    vfnmadd231ps ymm4, ymm1, ymm3                # x1*cos - x2*sin
    vmulps ymm5, ymm1, ymm2
    vfmadd231ps ymm5, ymm0, ymm3                 # x2*cos + x1*sin
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4], ymm4
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rcx+rax*4+256], ymm5
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, 64
    jb .Lrope_i
    inc r11
    jmp .Lrope_h
.Lrope_done:
    vzeroupper
    ret

# matvec: dst[b][r] = sum_c W[r][c] * X[b][c], W bf16 row-major
#   rdi = dst f32 (batch stride = rows), rsi = W bf16, rdx = X f32 (batch stride = cols),
#   rcx = rows, r8 = cols (multiple of 32), r9 = nb (batch size)
matvec:
    mov [rip+g_mv_dst], rdi
    mov [rip+g_mv_w], rsi
    mov [rip+g_mv_x], rdx
    mov [rip+g_mv_rows], rcx
    mov [rip+g_mv_cols], r8
    mov [rip+g_mv_nb], r9
.Lmv_loop:
    mov r9, [rip+g_mv_nb]
    test r9, r9
    jz .Lmv_ret
    mov rdi, [rip+g_mv_dst]
    mov rsi, [rip+g_mv_w]
    mov rdx, [rip+g_mv_x]
    mov rcx, [rip+g_mv_rows]
    mov r8, [rip+g_mv_cols]
    cmp r9, 4
    jb .Lmv_one
    call kernel4
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_rows]
    shl rax, 4                           # 4 outputs * rows * 4 bytes
    add [rip+g_mv_dst], rax
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_cols]
    shl rax, 4
    add [rip+g_mv_x], rax
    sub qword ptr [rip+g_mv_nb], 4
    jmp .Lmv_loop
.Lmv_one:
    call kernel1
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_rows]
    shl rax, 2
    add [rip+g_mv_dst], rax
    mov rax, [rip+g_mv_cols]
    shl rax, 2
    add [rip+g_mv_x], rax
    dec qword ptr [rip+g_mv_nb]
    jmp .Lmv_loop
.Lmv_ret:
    ret

# kernel1: one batch vector. rdi dst, rsi W, rdx x, rcx rows, r8 cols
kernel1:
    xor r10d, r10d
    mov r9, rsi
.Lk1_row:
    cmp r10, rcx
    jae .Lk1_done
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vxorps ymm1, ymm1, ymm1
    vxorps ymm2, ymm2, ymm2
    vxorps ymm3, ymm3, ymm3
    xor eax, eax
.Lk1_col:
    vpmovzxwd ymm4, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2]
    vpmovzxwd ymm5, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2+16]
    vpmovzxwd ymm6, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2+32]
    vpmovzxwd ymm7, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2+48]
    vpslld ymm4, ymm4, 16
    vpslld ymm5, ymm5, 16
    vpslld ymm6, ymm6, 16
    vpslld ymm7, ymm7, 16
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm1, ymm5, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4+32]
    vfmadd231ps ymm2, ymm6, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4+64]
    vfmadd231ps ymm3, ymm7, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4+96]
    add rax, 32
    cmp rax, r8
    jb .Lk1_col
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, ymm1
    vaddps ymm2, ymm2, ymm3
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, ymm2
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm4
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4], xmm0
    lea r9, [r9+r8*2]
    inc r10
    jmp .Lk1_row
.Lk1_done:
    vzeroupper
    ret

# kernel4: four batch vectors at once (x0 = rdx, x_i = x0 + i*cols) and outputs
#   at rdi + i*rows. Same arguments as kernel1.
kernel4:
    push rbx
    push rbp
    push r12
    push r13
    push r14
    push r15
    mov rax, r8
    shl rax, 2                           # cols * 4 bytes
    lea r12, [rdx+rax]
    lea r13, [r12+rax]
    lea r14, [r13+rax]
    mov rax, rcx
    shl rax, 2                           # rows * 4 bytes
    lea r15, [rdi+rax]
    lea rbp, [r15+rax]
    lea rbx, [rbp+rax]
    mov r9, rsi
    xor r10d, r10d
.Lk4_row:
    cmp r10, rcx
    jae .Lk4_done
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vxorps ymm1, ymm1, ymm1
    vxorps ymm2, ymm2, ymm2
    vxorps ymm3, ymm3, ymm3
    xor eax, eax
.Lk4_col:
    vpmovzxwd ymm4, XMMWORD PTR [r9+rax*2]
    vpslld ymm4, ymm4, 16
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [rdx+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm1, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [r12+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm2, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [r13+rax*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm3, ymm4, YMMWORD PTR [r14+rax*4]
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, r8
    jb .Lk4_col
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm4
    HSUM ymm1, xmm1, xmm4
    HSUM ymm2, xmm2, xmm4
    HSUM ymm3, xmm3, xmm4
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4], xmm0
    vmovss DWORD PTR [r15+r10*4], xmm1
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rbp+r10*4], xmm2
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rbx+r10*4], xmm3
    lea r9, [r9+r8*2]
    inc r10
    jmp .Lk4_row
.Lk4_done:
    vzeroupper
    pop r15
    pop r14
    pop r13
    pop r12
    pop rbp
    pop rbx
    ret

# exp8: ymm0 = exp(ymm0) for 8 lanes. Clobbers ymm0-ymm3 only.
#   Range reduction x = n*ln2 + r, polynomial for exp(r) (Cephes expf), 2^n by bit construction.
exp8:
    vminps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_EXPHI]
    vmaxps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_EXPLO]
    vmulps ymm1, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_LOG2E]
    vroundps ymm1, ymm1, 0               # n = round(x / ln2), nearest
    vmovaps ymm2, ymm0
    vfnmadd231ps ymm2, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_LN2HI]
    vfnmadd231ps ymm2, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_LN2LO]     # r = x - n*ln2
    vmovups ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P0]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P1]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P2]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P3]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P4]
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_P5]      # p = poly(r)
    vmulps ymm0, ymm2, ymm2                              # r^2
    vfmadd213ps ymm3, ymm0, ymm2                         # p = p*r^2 + r
    vaddps ymm3, ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_ONE]           # exp(r)
    vcvtps2dq ymm1, ymm1
    vpaddd ymm1, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_I127]
    vpslld ymm1, ymm1, 23                                # 2^n
    vmulps ymm0, ymm3, ymm1
    ret

# silu_mul: gate[i] = silu(gate[i]) * up[i]
#   rdi = gate f32, rsi = up f32, rdx = n (multiple of 8)
silu_mul:
    xor eax, eax
.Lsm:
    vmovups ymm5, YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4]        # g
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vsubps ymm0, ymm0, ymm5                      # -g
    call exp8
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rip+V_ONE]   # 1 + exp(-g)
    vdivps ymm1, ymm5, ymm0                      # g * sigmoid(g)
    vmulps ymm1, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm1
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rdx
    jb .Lsm
    vzeroupper
    ret

# add_vec: dst[i] += src[i]. rdi = dst, rsi = src, rdx = n (multiple of 8)
add_vec:
    xor eax, eax
.Lav:
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4]
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+rax*4]
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm0
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, rdx
    jb .Lav
    vzeroupper
    ret

# argmax: rdi = f32 array, rsi = n -> eax = index of first maximum
argmax:
    xor eax, eax
    vmovss xmm0, DWORD PTR [rdi]
    mov ecx, 1
.Lam:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jae .Lam_done
    vmovss xmm1, DWORD PTR [rdi+rcx*4]
    vucomiss xmm1, xmm0
    jbe .Lam_next
    vmovaps xmm0, xmm1
    mov eax, ecx
.Lam_next:
    inc rcx
    jmp .Lam
.Lam_done:
    ret

# attention for one query position (all 16 query heads, GQA 2:1).
#   rdi = q (16 heads x 128), rsi = K cache base for this layer,
#   rdx = V cache base for this layer, rcx = out (16 x 128), r8 = T (number of keys)
#   Key/value row t lives at base + t*KVD*4; kv head j at j*128*4.
attention:
    push rbx
    push rbp
    push r12
    push r13
    push r14
    push r15
    mov r12, rdi                         # q
    mov r13, rsi                         # K base
    mov r14, rdx                         # V base
    mov r15, rcx                         # out
    mov rbx, r8                          # T
    xor ebp, ebp                         # head
.Lat_head:
    cmp rbp, NH
    jae .Lat_done
    mov rax, rbp
    shr rax, 1
    shl rax, 9                           # kv head * 128 * 4
    lea rdx, [r13+rax]                   # K head base
    lea rcx, [r14+rax]                   # V head base
    mov r8, rbp
    shl r8, 9
    add r8, r12                          # q head

    # scores[t] = (q . k_t) / sqrt(HD)
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_sc:
    cmp r9, rbx
    jae .Lat_sc_done
    mov rsi, r9
    shl rsi, 12                          # t * KVD * 4
    add rsi, rdx
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    vxorps ymm1, ymm1, ymm1
    xor r10d, r10d
.Lat_dot:
    vmovups ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [r8+r10*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm0, ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+r10*4]
    vmovups ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [r8+r10*4+32]
    vfmadd231ps ymm1, ymm3, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+r10*4+32]
    add r10, 16
    cmp r10, HD
    jb .Lat_dot
    vaddps ymm0, ymm0, ymm1
    HSUM ymm0, xmm0, xmm2
    vmulss xmm0, xmm0, DWORD PTR [rip+S_SCALE]
    lea rax, [rip+g_scores]
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], xmm0
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_sc
.Lat_sc_done:

    # pad to a multiple of 8 with a very negative value
    lea rax, [rip+g_scores]
    mov r10, rbx
    add r10, 7
    and r10, -8                          # Tpad
    mov r9, rbx
    vmovss xmm3, DWORD PTR [rip+S_NEG]
.Lat_pad:
    cmp r9, r10
    jae .Lat_pad_done
    vmovss DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], xmm3
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_pad
.Lat_pad_done:

    # softmax: max, exp(x - max), normalise
    vmovss xmm1, DWORD PTR [rax]
    mov r9, 1
.Lat_max:
    cmp r9, rbx
    jae .Lat_max_done
    vmaxss xmm1, xmm1, DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_max
.Lat_max_done:
    vbroadcastss ymm7, xmm1
    vxorps ymm8, ymm8, ymm8
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_exp:
    cmp r9, r10
    jae .Lat_exp_done
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    vsubps ymm0, ymm0, ymm7
    call exp8
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], ymm0
    vaddps ymm8, ymm8, ymm0
    add r9, 8
    jmp .Lat_exp
.Lat_exp_done:
    HSUM ymm8, xmm8, xmm2
    vmovss xmm2, DWORD PTR [rip+S_ONE]
    vdivss xmm8, xmm2, xmm8
    vbroadcastss ymm9, xmm8
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_norm:
    cmp r9, r10
    jae .Lat_norm_done
    vmovups ymm0, YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    vmulps ymm0, ymm0, ymm9
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rax+r9*4], ymm0
    add r9, 8
    jmp .Lat_norm
.Lat_norm_done:

    # out_head = sum_t p[t] * v_t
    mov rdi, rbp
    shl rdi, 9
    add rdi, r15                         # out head
    vxorps ymm0, ymm0, ymm0
    xor eax, eax
.Lat_zero:
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+rax*4], ymm0
    add rax, 8
    cmp rax, HD
    jb .Lat_zero
    xor r9d, r9d
.Lat_acc:
    cmp r9, rbx
    jae .Lat_acc_done
    lea rax, [rip+g_scores]
    vbroadcastss ymm1, DWORD PTR [rax+r9*4]
    mov rsi, r9
    shl rsi, 12
    add rsi, rcx                         # V row t, this kv head
    xor r10d, r10d
.Lat_acc_d:
    vmovups ymm2, YMMWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4]
    vfmadd231ps ymm2, ymm1, YMMWORD PTR [rsi+r10*4]
    vmovups YMMWORD PTR [rdi+r10*4], ymm2
    add r10, 8
    cmp r10, HD
    jb .Lat_acc_d
    inc r9
    jmp .Lat_acc
.Lat_acc_done:
    inc rbp
    jmp .Lat_head
.Lat_done:
    vzeroupper
    pop r15
    pop r14
    pop r13
    pop r12
    pop rbp
    pop rbx
    ret

# ==========================================================================
# forward: process nb tokens (1..4) at positions p0 .. p0+nb-1.
#   rdi = pointer to nb u32 token IDs, rsi = p0, rdx = nb, rcx = want logits (0/1)
#   If want != 0, the argmax of the last token's logits is stored in g_next.
forward:
    push rbx
    push rbp
    push r12
    push r13
    push r14
    push r15
    mov [rip+g_fw_tok], rdi
    mov [rip+g_fw_p0], rsi
    mov [rip+g_fw_nb], rdx
    mov [rip+g_fw_want], rcx

    # embedding: x[b] = embed[token[b]]
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_emb:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_emb_done
    mov rax, [rip+g_fw_tok]
    mov eax, dword ptr [rax+rbx*4]
    imul rax, rax, H*2
    mov rsi, qword ptr [rip+g_slots]
    add rsi, rax
    mov rdi, rbx
    shl rdi, 12
    lea rax, [rip+g_x]
    add rdi, rax
    mov edx, H
    call bf16_to_f32
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_emb
.Lfw_emb_done:
    mov qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer], 0

.Lfw_layer:
    # ---- attention block ----------------------------------------------------
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_ln1:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_ln1_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_xn]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_x]
    add rsi, rax
    LSLOT rdx, 0
    mov ecx, H
    call rmsnorm
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_ln1
.Lfw_ln1_done:

    lea rdi, [rip+g_q]
    LSLOT rsi, 1
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, QD
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_k]
    LSLOT rsi, 2
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, KVD
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_v]
    LSLOT rsi, 3
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, KVD
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    # per-head QK RMSNorm, RoPE
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_qk:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_qk_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 13                          # b * QD * 4
    lea r12, [rip+g_q]
    add r12, rax
    xor r13d, r13d
.Lfw_qn:
    cmp r13, NH
    jae .Lfw_qn_done
    mov rax, r13
    shl rax, 9
    lea rdi, [r12+rax]
    mov rsi, rdi
    LSLOT rdx, 5
    mov ecx, HD
    call rmsnorm
    inc r13
    jmp .Lfw_qn
.Lfw_qn_done:
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12                          # b * KVD * 4
    lea r12, [rip+g_k]
    add r12, rax
    xor r13d, r13d
.Lfw_kn:
    cmp r13, NKV
    jae .Lfw_kn_done
    mov rax, r13
    shl rax, 9
    lea rdi, [r12+rax]
    mov rsi, rdi
    LSLOT rdx, 6
    mov ecx, HD
    call rmsnorm
    inc r13
    jmp .Lfw_kn
.Lfw_kn_done:

    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 13
    lea rdi, [rip+g_q]
    add rdi, rax
    mov esi, NH
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add rdx, rbx
    call rope

    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_k]
    add rdi, rax
    mov esi, NKV
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add rdx, rbx
    call rope
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_qk
.Lfw_qk_done:

    # write K and V for every batch position into the cache
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_kv:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_kv_done
    mov rax, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add rax, rbx                         # position
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_layer]
    imul rdx, rdx, MAXCTX
    add rdx, rax
    shl rdx, 12                          # (layer*MAXCTX + pos) * KVD * 4
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12                          # b * KVD * 4
    mov rdi, [rip+g_kcache]
    add rdi, rdx
    lea rsi, [rip+g_k]
    add rsi, rax
    mov ecx, KVD/2
    rep movsq
    mov rdi, [rip+g_vcache]
    add rdi, rdx
    lea rsi, [rip+g_v]
    add rsi, rax
    mov ecx, KVD/2
    rep movsq
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_kv
.Lfw_kv_done:

    # attention per batch position (causal: only keys 0..pos)
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_att:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_att_done
    mov rdx, [rip+g_fw_layer]
    imul rdx, rdx, MAXCTX*4096           # layer * MAXCTX * KVD * 4
    mov r9, rdx
    mov rsi, [rip+g_kcache]
    add rsi, r9
    mov rdx, [rip+g_vcache]
    add rdx, r9
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 13
    lea rdi, [rip+g_q]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rcx, [rip+g_att]
    add rcx, rax
    mov r8, [rip+g_fw_p0]
    add r8, rbx
    inc r8                               # T = pos + 1
    call attention
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_att
.Lfw_att_done:

    # output projection and residual
    lea rdi, [rip+g_tmp]
    LSLOT rsi, 4
    lea rdx, [rip+g_att]
    mov ecx, H
    mov r8d, QD
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_res1:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_res1_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_x]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_tmp]
    add rsi, rax
    mov edx, H
    call add_vec
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_res1
.Lfw_res1_done:

    # MLP: xn = rmsnorm(x) * ln2; h = silu(gate(xn)) * up(xn); x += down(h)
    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_ln2:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_ln2_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_xn]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_x]
    add rsi, rax
    LSLOT rdx, 7
    mov ecx, H
    call rmsnorm
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_ln2
.Lfw_ln2_done:

    lea rdi, [rip+g_gate]
    LSLOT rsi, 8
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, FF
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_up]
    LSLOT rsi, 9
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, FF
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_silu:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_silu_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 14                          # b * FF * 4
    lea rdi, [rip+g_gate]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_up]
    add rsi, rax
    mov edx, FF
    call silu_mul
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_silu
.Lfw_silu_done:

    lea rdi, [rip+g_tmp]
    LSLOT rsi, 10
    lea rdx, [rip+g_gate]
    mov ecx, H
    mov r8d, FF
    mov r9, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    call matvec

    xor ebx, ebx
.Lfw_res2:
    cmp rbx, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    jae .Lfw_res2_done
    mov rax, rbx
    shl rax, 12
    lea rdi, [rip+g_x]
    add rdi, rax
    lea rsi, [rip+g_tmp]
    add rsi, rax
    mov edx, H
    call add_vec
    inc rbx
    jmp .Lfw_res2
.Lfw_res2_done:

    inc qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer]
    cmp qword ptr [rip+g_fw_layer], NL
    jb .Lfw_layer

    # ---- final norm + tied LM head (logits = embed . xn) --------------------
    cmp qword ptr [rip+g_fw_want], 0
    je .Lfw_ret
    mov rax, [rip+g_fw_nb]
    dec rax
    shl rax, 12
    lea rsi, [rip+g_x]
    add rsi, rax
    lea rdi, [rip+g_xn]
    mov rdx, qword ptr [rip+g_slots+8]   # model.norm.weight
    mov ecx, H
    call rmsnorm

    lea rdi, [rip+g_logits]
    mov rsi, qword ptr [rip+g_slots]     # embed (V x H), used as lm_head
    lea rdx, [rip+g_xn]
    mov ecx, VOCAB
    mov r8d, H
    mov r9d, 1
    call matvec

    lea rdi, [rip+g_logits]
    mov esi, VOCAB
    call argmax
    mov [rip+g_next], eax

.Lfw_ret:
    pop r15
    pop r14
    pop r13
    pop r12
    pop rbp
    pop rbx
    ret

s_self:      .asciz "/proc/self/exe"
magic_blob:  .ascii "QWN3BLOB"
magic_trl:   .ascii "QWN3TRL1"
.align 4

.align 32
VEC V_EXPHI,  88.3762626647949
